title: Jennie Garth Recalls “Bad Vibes” From Dan Schneider on ‘What I Like About You,’ Requested to Only Communicate With Co-Creator Will Calhoun
summary: When first approached to star in the series, Garth said of Schneider, “He was kind of the Amanda [Bynes] side of it; she had worked with him a lot on 'The Amanda Show' and all the things. So, he had hooked his wagon onto her."
